population.site_histories: twelve constant histories and twenty-four varying histories with frame-unique labels, one assignment to sites across all frames including the guard
population.plant_order: uniform labeled pair of starts for the two ordered six-history blocks, disjoint and separated by at least one nuisance site, with uniform order of remaining histories

limits: one joint site-exchangeability null and one matched two-block plant, with simultaneous one-sided bounds; unresolved nulls count as possible rejections and unresolved plants as misses
